narration_text: Every night at one o'clock, a small program wakes up on this computer. First, it takes the oldest topic from the queue and writes a short script. Then a local voice engine reads the script aloud, and a speech model finds the exact time of every word. Next, an editor builds the scenes, and the video is rendered and checked frame by frame. Only a video that passes every check is saved and scheduled. By morning, the work is done.
